description: This file defines a Bootstrap plugin called ScrollSpy, which manages updating navigation based on scroll position. It includes class definition, plugin registration, and data API initialization.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: A class that manages updating navigation elements based on scroll position.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recalculates target offsets and targets for scrollspy.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles scroll event, activates the appropriate target based on scroll position.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a specific target, updating the active class in navigation.
